app.title: Codex Dashboard
state.noData: No recent Codex rate limit data found
state.noDataHint: Pick a session folder or check the default path.
status.scanFailedHint: Check folder access or pick a different sessions root.
status.configNotSaved: The folder choice could not be saved.
permission.denied.fs_read: Reading the session folder was denied, so rate limits cannot be shown.
permission.denied.fs_write: Saving the settings file was denied, so the folder you pick is not remembered.
permission.denied.process_exec: Running the log reader was denied, so session files cannot be read.
permission.hint.fs_read: Allow it in Settings > Plugins, or press [p] to pick a folder you can read.
permission.hint.fs_write: Allow file writing for this plugin in Settings > Plugins.
permission.hint.process_exec: Allow running programs for this plugin in Settings > Plugins.
permission.reason.fs_read: Read the Codex session logs in the folder shown on the dashboard to display your remaining rate limits and token usage.
permission.reason.fs_write: Save the session folder you picked so the dashboard reopens with the same folder.
permission.reason.process_exec: Run tail (PowerShell Get-Content on Windows) to read the last lines of a session log, so a large log does not have to be loaded in full.
hooks.state.stale: Out of date — press [h] to update
bookmark.label: Codex · {message} {time}
status.hooksInstalled: Codex hooks installed in {path}. Codex may ask you to trust them on its next start.
status.hooksFailed: Codex hooks could not be installed: {error}
permission.reason.network_serve: Listen on 127.0.0.1 port 9219 so Codex hooks on this machine can tell the dashboard when a turn ends. Only local connections are accepted.
permission.reason.terminal_status: Bookmark the spot in the terminal where Codex finished a turn or stopped for your approval.
